title: HTTP Middleware and Rate Headers
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: HTTP Middleware and Rate Headers.
learning_objectives: Explain http middleware and rate headers using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for http middleware and rate headers

Blocked path sets Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Remaining.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
